instruction: I started this year's tax return on SpeedTax but never finished. Walk through the in-progress current-year return — review my wages and any freelance/1099 income, look over the deductions section, and click Continue all the way through to the review step (step 6) so I can see what I'd actually owe or get back. Don't submit it yet, just get it ready for me to eyeball.
required_subtasks: Open SpeedTax and locate the in-progress current-year tax return
Open the wages step and inspect the W-2 documents pre-loaded into the return
Open the freelance/1099 income step and inspect any income documents pre-loaded into the return
Open the deductions step and inspect the seeded deduction values (mortgage interest, state/local tax, charitable, medical)
Click Continue / Save & Continue from each completed step until the return reaches the review step (step 6)
Confirm the return is parked at the review step (step 6) in 'review' or 'in_progress' status (not filed)

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens SpeedTax and selects the unfiled tax-year 2025 return labeled 'In progress' or 'Ready for review', not a filed return
Agent reviews step 2 and reports the W-2 wage amount loaded in the 2025 return
Agent reviews step 3 and accurately reports whether any freelance/1099 income is loaded, without inventing a number
Agent reviews step 4 and reports the seeded deduction inputs that are present rather than skipping the section
Agent advances the 2025 return through Continue or Save & Continue until review step 6 is active
Agent leaves the 2025 return at review step 6 without submitting or filing it

date_policy_notes: Tax year 2025 is an explicit fixed property of the seeded return; the task no longer calls it the current-year return.

instruction: Pull up my prior-year tax returns on SpeedTax and tell me my combined federal + state refund across the most recent filed years. I want one number that says 'over the last few years you've gotten back X total.'
required_subtasks: Open SpeedTax and list the persona's tax returns
Filter to returns with status 'filed' and tax_year strictly less than the current tax year
Read each filed prior-year return's federal_refund_amount and state_refund_amount
Sum federal+state refunds across those filed prior-year returns
Report the combined federal+state refund total with the count of prior years included

rubrics.criterion: Agent restricts the rollup to SpeedTax returns whose status is 'filed' and tax_year is strictly less than the current tax year, excluding any in-progress current-year return
Agent reads both federal_refund_amount and state_refund_amount from each filed prior-year return rather than reading only one of the two refund fields
Agent sums federal+state refunds across the filed prior-year returns and reports a single combined total alongside the count of prior years included
Agent answers the persona's 'over the last few years' framing with a relative-year description (e.g. 'across the most recent N filed years') rather than hardcoding absolute calendar years

instruction: On SpeedTax, find my W-2 from last year's filed return — the most recent prior-year one — and tell me the wages amount on it. Just the number from the W-2, not the refund.
required_subtasks: Open SpeedTax and locate the most recent prior-year filed return (status='filed', tax_year=current_year-1 if present, else the highest filed tax_year < current)

Read the W-2 document on that return — either by navigating to the wages step (filed returns redirect to /file which still surfaces the W-2 row) or by reading /returns/<id> overview / /api/returns/<id> documents
Report the W-2 wages amount as a single dollar figure

rubrics.criterion: Agent picks the most recent prior-year filed return on SpeedTax (status='filed' and tax_year strictly less than the current tax year, choosing the highest such tax_year) and not the in-progress current-year return

Agent reads the W-2 document on the prior-year return — either by opening the wages step UI, navigating to the filed-return overview page, or via /api/returns/<id> documents — instead of inferring wages from the refund amount
Agent reports the W-2 wages amount as a single dollar figure for that prior-year W-2 and does not return the refund amount instead
